summary: The MaintProgramProfileInstructorAccess control manages instructor access to program profiles, including selection and updating of program data. It utilizes HSPnet session data for data source operations.
purpose: To manage instructor access and modification capabilities for program profiles.

workflows.name: Instructor Access Management
steps: Select program data using session parameters
Update program data with session parameters

system_behavior: Grant access to program profiles for instructors
Update visibility based on session and input parameters
